prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1446; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a side impact collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a vehicle that failed to yield. Police report requested. Liability appears disputed at this stage pending witness statements.

Entry 2: Claimant reports knee injury from the impact and has retained counsel. All further contact to be directed through the attorney's office. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel for signature. Photos of both vehicles received and added to file.

Entry 3: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding scope of injury. Attorney advised client has begun treatment with an orthopedic provider and an MRI has been ordered. Requested copies of all medical records and bills once available. Reserve reviewed and left unchanged for now.

Entry 4: Received police report. Officer noted the other driver admitted to not seeing the signal. Witness statement obtained from a pedestrian at the corner supporting the insured's account of the light. Liability position revised to favor insured, subject to final review.

Entry 5: Attorney's office submitted an initial demand package including treatment notes and wage documentation. Demand exceeds current reserve and is under review. Scheduled internal discussion with supervisor to evaluate settlement range and whether independent medical review is warranted before responding.
